precision_steps: Partition K into contiguous K/split_k segments. Within each TILE_K, assign each K warp its contiguous TILE_K/k_warps slice.
FP32 MFMA accumulation, then arith.truncf to BF16 in LDS. Round-to-nearest-even is independently reproduced by CPU BF16 conversion and verified by actual GPU results.
Add K-warp BF16 slices in increasing warp order, rounding to BF16 per addition.
For split_k>1, native vector<2xbf16> atomic fadd permits different split arrival orders. Both lanes of a packed pair share one order and round to BF16 after every update.
acceptance: Check EVERY native output element at original rtol0.01/atol0.02 against independent FP32. For EACH pair containing any failure, require BIT-EXACT equality to one legal input-derived BF16 atomic arrival order. No interval or increased tolerance accepts an exception. Candidate outputs remain strictly checked against FP32.
